name: screen-live
description: Reunião por vídeo com compartilhamento de tela, no estilo Meet, com SFU mediasoup

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
